title: 💠 **Hormuz Hunting Ground: Recording the Moment of Destruction of the 55th Advanced American MQ-9 Drone in the Sky over the Strait of Hormuz**
text:
💠 **Hormuz Hunting Ground: Recording the Moment of Destruction of the 55th Advanced American MQ-9 Drone in the Sky over the Strait of Hormuz**"

"🔹 The present footage shows the moment an air-defense missile directly hit an advanced American MQ-9 Reaper drone in the sky east of the Strait of Hormuz. "

"According to last night’s report, this aircraft, one of the most valuable reconnaissance and combat drones of the aggressive U.S. military, was intercepted and destroyed last night by the action of a new air-defense system of the Aerospace Force of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, under the guidance and control of the country’s integrated air-defense network. "

"Counting this interception, the number of American MQ-9 drones whose destruction has been announced has reached 55, a statistic that indicates heavy damage to the U.S. drone fleet. "

"The sky east of the Strait of Hormuz once again became the scene of the crash of one of the most expensive American unmanned aircraft.
